content: {"text": "The 2028-01-31 target completion date is at risk: probability of meeting it is only 17.8%, with a P50 finish of 2028-06-07 versus a planned finish of 2027-09-22 absent material risk. The single item driving this is PO-1003, the two 3000 kW diesel standby generator sets, whose expected project delay is 97.2 days against a need-by date of 2027-12-03. Top mitigation: obtain from Konark Power Gen a confirmed factory production slot and ship date in writing, backed by weekly expediting calls. Because the order date of 2026-10-05 falls after the latest order date for 80% confidence (2026-02-02), qualify an alternate source or equivalent product. Secondary exposure comes from PO-1001 switchgear (21.9 days expected delay rev 39.1% late probability) and PO-1002 transformers (4.2 days, 16.1%), which should be tracked alongside the generator action."}
